🇪🇪 Estonia: 24% VAT

Käibemaks (km) · Currency: EUR · Last verified: 2026-08-23 · Source: European Commission TEDB

Standard rate24%
Reduced rates9%, 13%
Super-reduced—
Parking rate—
Example100,00 € net + 24,00 € VAT = 124,00 € total

Estonia charges käibemaks at a 24% standard rate, with 9% and 13% reduced rates for qualifying categories in national law. It sits at the higher end of EU headline rates, so pricing "VAT included" for Estonian buyers needs a visibly bigger gross-up than for Germany or Luxembourg.

Amounts appear in euro with Estonian formatting. Cross-border B2C digital sales to Estonia can generally go through the EU One-Stop Shop rather than a separate Estonian registration — check with your accountant.

Frequently asked questions

What is the standard VAT rate in Estonia?

The standard VAT rate in Estonia (Käibemaks, km) is 24%, according to the eu-vat-rates-data package (source: European Commission TEDB, last verified 2026-08-23). Most goods sold to Estonia customers use this rate.

Does Estonia have reduced VAT rates?

Yes — Estonia applies reduced rates of 9%, 13%. They cover only the categories defined in national law; everything else uses the 24% standard rate.

What is the VAT rate in Estonia for digital products?

B2C digital products sold to consumers in Estonia are generally taxed at Estonia's applicable VAT rate (24% standard unless a reduced band explicitly covers the product). Cross-border sellers can usually report this through the EU One-Stop Shop (OSS) instead of registering locally — confirm with an accountant or the official EU TEDB source.
